tagline: Live judging and leaderboard · Northern Warrior Competitions
brief: The judging, leaderboard and big-screen app for the Northern Warrior pairs competition. It has to be bold and competitive, read on a judge's phone, a browser tab and a TV, and sit in the Northern Warrior black-and-gold family.
criteria: Success: reads as WL at 16 px, no trophy/podium clichés, works in one colour and reversed, clearly part of Northern Warrior.

concepts.name: Sprint WL
concepts.idea: A W that climbs peak by peak, and a gold L leaning forward beside it like a sprint finish.
rationale: Every stroke at the same 75° lean: one motion, built on one stroke width
The climb says 'moving up the board'; the gold L is the leader
Black and gold ties it to Northern Warrior Competitions
Small-size cut with a wider W–L gap holds up at 16 px

recommendation: Sprint WL with the two-line WARRIOR / LEADERS lockup as the main logo; the WL mark alone for the app icon, favicon and judge app.
next_steps: Swap the new icons and logo into leaders.northernwarrior.co.uk
Print judge lanyards and the big-screen header
